complete_source_row.english: Virtue taken in by the realm of desire represents a type of deed which is both white and black, and which also ripens into something both white and black. Since its basic nature is free of affliction it is white but--since within a single mental stream it is also mixed with afflicted things--it is black as well. It ripens into something white because it gives forth a pleasant result but--since within the particular mental stream this is also mixed with suffering--we can also say it ripens into something black.
